# Introduction

This vignette provides a step-by-step replication guide for analyzing shareholding concentration (HSC) and verifiable free float across Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) listed equities using PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI) $>1\%$ ownership registers.

The **`CobwebR`** framework addresses three core analytical components in emerging equity markets:

* **The HSC Frontier:** Identifying stocks whose top-10 shareholding concentration meets or exceeds the regulatory threshold (e.g., $92.5\%$), capturing both officially designated HSC stocks and hidden concentrated equivalents.
* **Spider Web Cross-Ownership:** Mapping indirect control webs and group-linked co-holdings among blockholders below $5\%$.
* **The Green List Screener:** Filtering a rules-based universe of verifiable free float tradability with genuine institutional participation.

# Data Ingestion and Cleaning

We load the raw monthly KSEI $>1\%$ ownership dataset (e.g., October 2026 register) and standardize investor classifications, scripless vs. scrip holdings, and corporate identifiers.

```{r load-data}
# Path to bundled sample dataset
sample_file <- system.file("extdata", "peng-2026-10-00029-satu-persen.xlsx", package = "CobwebR")

# If running outside package build directory, load directly:
if (sample_file == "") {
  sample_file <- "../inst/extdata/peng-2026-10-00029-satu-persen.xlsx"
}

ksei_clean <- load_ksei_register(sample_file)

# Inspect dimensions and top rows
dim(ksei_clean)
head(ksei_clean %>% select(ticker, issuer_name, investor_name, percentage), 5)

```

# Calculating the HSC Frontier

The High Shareholding Concentration (HSC) frontier calculates the aggregate stake held by the top 10 shareholders owning $>1\%$ of each issuer. Stocks with a top-10 stake $\ge 92.5\%$ are classified as **Inside** the HSC frontier.

```{r hsc-frontier}
# Compute HSC frontier summary
frontier_results <- calculate_hsc_frontier(ksei_clean, threshold = 0.925)

# Summary counts
frontier_summary_table <- frontier_results %>%
  count(frontier_status)

print(frontier_summary_table)

# View top 10 most concentrated stocks
frontier_results %>%
  arrange(desc(stake_top_10)) %>%
  select(ticker, issuer_name, stake_top_10, largest_holder) %>%
  head(10)

```

# Mapping Spider Web Cross-Ownership

To detect indirect control and cross-ownership webs, we analyze co-holder recurrences across multiple tickers. Holders appearing across multiple distinct companies are flagged for network consolidation.

```{r spider-web}
# Identify group-linked holders
ksei_network_flagged <- identify_group_links(ksei_clean)

# Count group-linked entities
group_linked_summary <- ksei_network_flagged %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    group_linked_records = sum(is_group_linked, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_linked = mean(is_group_linked, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )

print(group_linked_summary)

```

# Executing the Green List Screener

The Green List isolates liquid, transparent equities with verified free float tradability across six sequential criteria ($\text{I}$, $\text{F}$, $\text{B}$, $\text{P}$, $\text{S}$, $\text{L}$):

* **Integrity ($\text{I}$):** Excludes HSC-designated stocks and suspension cases.
* **Free Float ($\text{F}$):** Free float $\ge 15\%$, total owner concentration $\le 85\%$.
* **Broker Concentration ($\text{B}$):** Top broker share $< 30\%$.
* **Institutional Participation ($\text{P}$):** Verified institutional holding rules.
* **Size ($\text{S}$):** Free float market capitalization $\ge \text{IDR } 1\text{tn}$.
* **Liquidity ($\text{L}$):** ADTV complementary screening.

```{r green-list}
# Simulated market data join for screening demonstration
market_dummy <- frontier_results %>%
  mutate(
    criterion_integrity = (frontier_status == "Outside"),
    criterion_free_float = 1 - stake_top_10,
    criterion_owner_conc = stake_top_10,
    criterion_broker_top = 0.20,
    criterion_institutional = TRUE,
    criterion_size_ffmc = 2.5, # IDR trillion
    free_float_mcap = stake_top_10 * 1000
  )

green_list_stocks <- run_green_list_screener(ksei_clean, market_dummy)

# Number of passing stocks
nrow(green_list_stocks)

```

# Visualizing Results

We generate publication-ready plots illustrating the concentration distribution across the HSC frontier.

```{r plot-frontier, fig.cap="Top-10 Stakeholder Concentration Across IDX Equities"}
plot_hsc_frontier(frontier_results %>% head(25))

```
